parse_deepseek_v3_tool_calls: parse the DeepSeek V3 tool call parser to extract structured tool calls from raw model output text
register_deepseek_v3_parser: register the DeepSeekV3ToolCallParser class with the tool call parser registry using the deepseek_v3 name
extract_multiple_tool_calls: extract all simultaneous tool calls from DeepSeek V3 formatted output using the regex pattern
get_deepseek_v3_parser: get an instantiated DeepSeekV3ToolCallParser from the parser registry by name
strip_tool_call_markup: strip tool call markup from raw model output and return clean content text alongside parsed tool calls
